title: Grounded 8-K Event Taxonomy as Third Filter for H174 PEAD — Quality-Scored Fine-Grained Event Type Gate
source: arXiv:2607.08346 (Jul 2026) — "Grounded Event Extraction from SEC 8-K Filings with a Fine-Grained Taxonomy"
summary: The paper builds a two-stage LLM system applied to 300K+ 8-K filings (2022–2026), producing 600K+ grounded event tags across 119 event types in three tiers. Precision scales from 12% to 96% as quality scores rise — quality-scored tags are highly reliable. An event study confirms these fine-grained types have economically distinct market impacts that current SEC item codes conflate. H469 adds a third filter to H174 (FinBERT score ≥ 0.18 + EPS surprise ≥ 0.02): the 8-K must contain at least one high-quality (score ≥ 0.7) Tier-1 or Tier-2 earnings-positive event tag (e.g. 'revenue-beat', 'guidance-raised', 'margin-expansion'). Implementation path: (a) build a lightweight event tagger using gpt-4o-mini with the paper's taxonomy prompt, (b) apply to H174 8-K texts already downloaded, (c) filter to events where event_type ∈ positive_earnings_taxonomy AND quality_score ≥ 0.7. Gate maintains H174 WR ≥ 0.818 at n ≥ 12 (lower n threshold than H174's 15 due to tighter filter).
variants: Var A: H174 base + event_type ∈ {'revenue-beat','guidance-raised','margin-expansion'} AND quality ≥ 0.7 (strict taxonomy filter)
Var B: H174 base + any Tier-1 earnings event AND quality ≥ 0.5 (broader, more permissive)
Var C: H174 base + event taxonomy score added as continuous factor to FinBERT score (weighted sum: 0.7*finbert + 0.3*taxonomy_score)
Var D: H174 baseline (FinBERT ≥ 0.18 + EPS surprise ≥ 0.02) — sanity check
gate: OOS WR >= 0.818 AND n >= 12 (maintain H174 win rate with tighter filter reducing sample size)
data_requirements: 8-K filing texts already in EDGAR download pipeline. gpt-4o-mini for event tagging (~$0.002/filing at current pricing — budget ~$5 for OOS test set). Taxonomy prompt can be constructed from paper's 3-tier taxonomy description.
implementation_notes: The 119-event taxonomy can be approximated with a reduced set of 20-30 earnings-relevant types. Quality scoring requires the second-stage re-evaluation pass — can be approximated by asking the LLM to self-rate confidence on a 0-1 scale. Paper covers 2022-2026 filings so IS/OOS split aligns with available data. Risk: gpt-4o-mini extraction quality may not reach paper's 96% precision at high quality threshold — empirical validation needed.
